title.zh: 有限接续充分性与分支方案
title.en: Finite continuation adequacy and branching plans

claim.zh: 给定转移、观察、目标与许可时，n 步 viable 等价于存在一个依观察分支且 works 的 n 步方案。
claim.en: For supplied transitions, observations, target and admissibility, n-step viable is equivalent to an observation-branching n-step plan satisfying works.

hypotheses.zh: 有限步数与现有 viable、Plan、works；观察分支的选择使用所列既有逻辑依赖。
hypotheses.en: Finite horizon and the existing viable, Plan and works; branch selection retains the recorded logical dependencies.

correspondence.zh: 模型中的许可不自动是伦理正当性；作用覆盖与观察校准另需根据。
correspondence.en: Model admissibility is not automatically ethical permission; effect coverage and observation calibration require warrant.

detail.zh: 一阶可共同采取的行动不保证第二步；所列盲观察例保留失败。
detail.en: A common first response need not support the second step; the blind-observation example retains the failure.

limitations.zh: 一阶可共同采取的行动不保证第二步；所列盲观察例保留失败。
limitations.en: A common first response need not support the second step; the blind-observation example retains the failure.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 复用有限方案接口；无限接续和实际取得足够观察仍单独研究。
next_delta.en: Reuse the finite-plan interface; infinite continuation and actual acquisition of sufficient observation remain separate.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
